rubrics.justification: Description is largely consistent with a 3BA blastocyst: expanded cavity, visible ICM cluster, and cohesive TE. Minor overstatement of certainty from a single image and limited acknowledgment that exact TE/ICM grading can be difficult from this view.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with a sensible prognosis estimate. Minor issues include somewhat speculative quantitative adjustments and strong emphasis on alcohol effect magnitude without case-specific evidence.

Generally aligns with Gardner grading, SET recommendations for a favorable young patient, luteal support, and PCOS-aware planning. Small deviations include speculative endorsement of PGT-A in a 26-year-old favorable-prognosis patient and some nonstandard adjunct suggestions.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, lifestyle modification, luteal support, embryo cryopreservation, and future cycle planning with practical specificity.
